verdict.rationale: TruffleHog's core documented functionality is scanning git repos (and full history via commands like `trufflehog github --repo ...`) for hardcoded secrets, with 800+ detectors and live verification, corroborated by both official docs and GitHub README. Community commentary criticizes maturity/hype but does not contradict the core git-history scanning capability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmark of full-history scan accuracy/performance beyond vendor docs.
